history.administration_response: The Administration will continue to review and update the strategies as necessary, based on evolving business needs. An updated timeline with target dates for the remaining strategies is currently being prepared. Regarding secondary bidding, the Administration closely monitors both the process and the Organization’s expenditure. Under the latest roster arrangement contracts, one secondary bidding exercise was conducted and the unit rates in the awarded task order were lower than the original contract unit rates. This indicates that the results of conducting secondary bidding are proving positive.
